blocks.html: We use three kinds of cookies on this website:

• Strictly necessary — required for core functionality such as security and session handling. These always load and cannot be switched off.
  • Analytics — help us understand which pages are useful and where visitors leave. These load only after consent.
  • Preferences — remember choices such as your preferred view or language.
Why we use them
Strictly necessary cookies keep the site working; analytics cookies tell us how the site performs; preferences cookies remember your choices. We do not use advertising cookies on this website.
Third-party cookies
Analytics is provided by Google Analytics 4. Data is processed in line with Google's privacy policy and only after you accept analytics cookies.
Managing cookies

You can accept or decline optional cookies through the consent banner on every page, or change your choice later via your browser settings. Declining analytics cookies does not affect how the site works.

blocks.p: The ERP is rolling out in phases. Live demos are offered for businesses that are ready; for pre-launch clients we run structured discovery.

items: Do I need to install anything?
No. The ERP runs in the browser and on mobile apps; data lives in the cloud. Staff log in with individual accounts and roles.
Read-only caching for offline views is supported; writes sync when back online. Full offline-first behaviour is on the Phase 3 roadmap.
Can you move my existing data?
Yes — we run a data-mapping discovery before migration and test a sample migration. Exact scope depends on the legacy system.
What happens to my data if I stop?
You can export your data at any time in standard formats; the licence continues for usage of the exported data.

blocks.html: Questions We Get Asked

items: Is my small business really a target?
Yes. Most attacks are automated and don't choose victims — they scan for weak sites and reused passwords. Small businesses are attractive because they often have no monitoring.
What happens in a security audit?
We check your website, accounts, backups, devices and staff practices, then give you a written report ranked by urgency. We don't change anything until you approve the fixes.

Yes. We isolate the site, clean it, close the entry point and restore from a safe backup. Then we tell you honestly what happened and how to stop it recurring.
How often should we check security?
A full check once a year, a quick re-check every quarter, and immediately after any staff change or new online system.
